test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I have not seen __you for last year__.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**you since last year**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Since**" is used to indicate a point in time that marks the beginning of a period of time that continues until the present
 
• "**For**" is used to indicate the duration of time that has passed
 
• Therefore, "**you since last year**" is the correct option as it indicates that the speaker has not seen the person since last year, which is a point in time that marks the beginning of the period of time until the present.

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence**: *I have not seen you since last year.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**me for last year**" is grammatically incorrect as it does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• "**you about last year**" is incorrect as it does not convey the same meaning as the original sentence.
 
• "**you for last years**" is incorrect as it uses the plural form of "year" which is not appropriate in this context.
